name: review-findings-round
title: fix: 独立审查发现的 serde 严格模式枚举缺失等 7 项问题（票 5cy）
description: 独立 adversarial review 发现：1) 高风险——JsonPlusSerializer(allowed_msgpack_modules=...) 会切 strict 模式，只 allowlist WorkflowPhase/WorkflowMode 导致 ContentStatus/ContentType/Urgency/ExecutionMode 被 Blocked 降级为 str（evaluator/human_feedback 的 decision 字段真实受影响）；2) 中——lifespan 启动失败路径不关闭 dev SQLite graph，uvicorn startup failed 后进程仍挂起；3) 中——两个 off-loop 测试在 gather 之后断言 ticks，是 vacuous（gather 等 ticker 跑完）；4) 中低——accounts._resolve_cdp_host lru_cache 永久缓存负结果 127.0.0.1；5) 低——close 路径 suppress 无日志（首次修复就是这样被吞掉的）；6) 低——off-loop 测试真实触发 12s DNS；7) 低——_clear_cdp_probe_cache docstring 暗示生产用途；9) 类型注解 tuple[tuple[str,...]] 过宽。修复：allowlist 全部 6 个枚举并加嵌套 payload 身份测试；lifespan 启动尾部 try/except 统一关闭 store/pool/dev graph 再抛出；TTL 化 accounts host 缓存并改用 socket patch 的测试；两个 off-loop 测试改为在 endpoint 返回时采样 ticks；close 失败改 logging.warning；docstring/注解修正。全量回归后提交。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-04. An independent adversarial review of aa014c88..HEAD found one high-risk defect plus several medium/low issues; all actionable ones fixed here. (1) HIGH: JsonPlusSerializer(allowed_msgpack_modules=...) switches the msgpack hook to strict mode, so the two-item allowlist silently blocked every other project enum: ContentStatus came back as the plain string 'approved' with 'Blocked deserialization ... not in allowed_msgpack_modules', and ContentStatus/ContentType/Urgency/ExecutionMode are real checkpoint payloads (evaluator decision, human_feedback decision). Allowlist now names all six enums; the unit test pins the full set, round-trips every member, and asserts nested evaluator/human_feedback payloads keep enum identity. (2) MED: the lifespan startup body had no try/except, so a raise after compile_graph_dev (bad Settings, Ripple init) skipped the dev-SQLite close and the process hung instead of exiting with the error; the startup tail is now wrapped and closes store_context/checkpoint_pool/dev graph before re-raising, with a new test that forces a startup failure and asserts the aiosqlite close is awaited. (3) MED tests: both off-loop tests asserted the tick counter after asyncio.gather, which is vacuous because gather waits for the ticker; they now sample the counter inside the endpoint coroutine at return time. (4) MED-LOW: accounts._resolve_cdp_host no longer lru_caches the negative 127.0.0.1 forever; it uses the same 60s TTL as the publisher probe (and catches OSError defensively), so a container host that resolves late recovers. (5) LOW: the close path logs a warning instead of silently suppressing; builder.close_dev_graph does too. (6) LOW: the accounts test no longer performs a real 12s DNS lookup (fake clock + patched resolver). (7) LOW: _clear_cdp_probe_cache docstring marked test seam. (8) TYPE: allowlist annotation narrowed to tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]. Not fixed: the preload test is a smoke-level seam (sys.modules membership) — reviewer agreed it is not currently broken; the new startup test and serde test cover the real failure modes. Docs updated: deployment.md now says the allowlist must cover all state enums and that strict mode silently downgrades missing ones; per-account CDP host TTL documented. Full suite + static checks re-run after the changes.
